library.name: Rongmei Hymnal
library.eyebrow: A digital library for singing communities
library.title: Rongmei songs, gathered for every generation.
library.intro: Explore Rongmei gospel songbooks in a simple digital library made for worship, learning, and singing together. Search across the collection or open a book and read each song in a clear, focused view.
library.about: Rongmei Hymnal helps preserve and share the songs that carry faith, language, and community memory. Each songbook remains a distinct, carefully credited collection, with its editorial, publication, source, and rights information kept alongside the songs.
